verdicts.title: Partition Arguments in Multiparty Communication Complexity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:

verdicts.title: Cut query algorithms with star contraction
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the complexity of determining the edge connectivity of a simple graph with cut queries. We show that (i) there is a bounded-error randomized algorithm that computes edge connectivity with $O(n)$ cut queries, and (ii) there is a bounded-error quantum algorithm that computes edge connectivity with $Õ(\sqrt{n})$ cut queries.
